model_output:
```sql
WITH kismet_geometry AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Kismet%'
    AND border_type = 'city'
    AND ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('omitted_large_wkt_876_chars'), 4326) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT MIN(value) AS lowest_elevation
FROM (
  SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, k.geom, TRUE))).min AS value
  FROM public.dem_us r, kismet_geometry k
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, k.geom)
) AS stats;
```
